summary: Iteration 16 frontend-only regression on web preview: GREEN (4/4 acceptance items pass). (1) Home (/) still loads after initBackend gate — 23 track-rows + 3 mix cards render, no blank screen, no red-screen. (2) Settings /settings 'Server' section verified: testID `server-row` renders, `server-url` input is prefilled with https://rhythm-glass-ui.preview.emergentagent.com (matches getBackend()); typing an invalid URL 'https://example.invalid' and tapping `server-save` shows an error `app-toast` with the exact text 'Couldn't reach a LiquidAudio server at that URL' (also raises expected ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED in console). `server-reset` button IS visible when the field differs from defaultBackend, tapping it restores the preview URL; `server-save` then shows a success `app-toast` with exactly 'Connected — songs now load from this server'. After the round-trip Home reloads and re-renders all 23 tracks. localStorage `liquidaudio.serverUrl` is correctly kept empty when URL == defaultBackend (per api.ts setBackendUrl branch). (3) Equalizer (/(tabs)/equalizer via Sound tab): `equalizer-screen` mounts, `hd-enhance` card renders with title 'HD Enhance' and subtitle 'Clarity, air and tighter bass with gentle loudness and stereo widening'; tapping the card flips localStorage `liquidaudio.eq` from {…,"hdEnhance":false} to {…,"hdEnhance":true}; the value survives a full page reload (verified by reading localStorage after page.reload). 9 presets (Flat…Lounge), 10 EQ faders (32→16k) and 4 effect cards (Bass Boost, 3D Surround, Reverb, Loudness) all still render; footer note reads 'EQ presets & effects are saved to this device. Sound shaping activates on the Android app build' (AudioFx.available=false on web, as expected). (4) Play regression: tapped first track-row (`track-row-lAiLvVyf` → 'Jaan Ban Gaye'), mini-player appeared with title+artist, tapping it opened the player screen; `player-play-toggle`, `player-tab-lyrics` and `player-tab-upnext` all exist; switching to Lyrics tab renders `lyrics-view` with synced lyrics. The only page-errors are the expected web audio-decode errors ('Failed to load because no supported source was found') per review-request notes — ignored. No red screen, no Invariant Violation, no module-not-found. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the changed files (api.ts, settings.tsx, (tabs)/equalizer.tsx, modules/audio-fx/index.ts). Native DSP is Android-only and cannot be validated on web preview.
action_items: None blocking. Real EQ/HD-Enhance DSP is Android-native (modules/audio-fx) and MUST be validated on a native Android build (EAS dev-client or `expo run:android`) — cannot be exercised on web.

Documentation nit: review-request says the success toast should appear after the reset action; behavior confirmed: pressing `server-reset` only refills the input, and the toast fires on the subsequent `server-save` tap — matches the code and the acceptance criteria.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts:12 — DEFAULT_BACKEND resolution order (override → EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL → Constants.expoConfig.extra.backendUrl) is correct; setBackendUrl(url === defaultBackend ? '' : url) correctly avoids writing an override when the user resets to the default. Verified via localStorage (`liquidaudio.serverUrl` is null after reset+save).

/app/frontend/app/settings.tsx:48 — saveServer() probes `<url>/api/` and expects `{status:'ok'}`. Backend confirmed reachable at that path. Error branch shows exact toast copy 'Couldn't reach a LiquidAudio server at that URL' — matches acceptance criteria.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/equalizer.tsx:69-95 — hdEnhance state is initialized from storage, persisted on every change, and passed to AudioFx.apply(). Persistence across reload verified; AudioFx is a web no-op (modules/audio-fx/index.ts) so no runtime error on web.

/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/equalizer.tsx:148-178 — The whole HD card is a Pressable that toggles hdEnhance AND contains an inner <Switch> that also toggles it. Tapping the switch fires BOTH handlers (event bubbles to the Pressable), producing a double-toggle back to the previous state. Recommend wrapping the Switch's onValueChange in e.stopPropagation via a wrapper View with onStartShouldSetResponder, or moving the Switch outside the Pressable. Not a blocker for this iter — tapping the card body (as the acceptance test does) works correctly and persists — but tapping the switch itself is a UX bug. LOW priority.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set localStorage `liquidaudio.autoplay=false` during the playback sub-test to prevent web audio-decode errors from auto-advancing the queue. No backend data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview URL: https://rhythm-glass-ui.preview.emergentagent.com. For Settings server test, remember `server-reset` only fills the input — the toast fires from the next `server-save` tap. For RN TextInput on web, use element.click() then page.keyboard.type() (page.fill() does not fire onChangeText). The HD Enhance card has both a card-level Pressable AND an inner Switch — tap the CARD body to avoid the double-toggle bubbling issue (see critical_code_review_comments). Expected/ignorable web console noise: 'Failed to load because no supported source was found', autoplay/NotAllowedError, Reanimated layout warnings. Native Android DSP (real HD-Enhance / EQ) can only be validated with a native build.
rca_of_issue: N/A — regression only, no bug. Only minor observation: HD Enhance card has a double-tap-target (outer Pressable + inner Switch) that could double-toggle when the Switch is tapped directly. Documented under critical_code_review_comments (LOW).
